第3章荒山孤坟借狐粮
“得买些洗换的衣物，虽然筑基道体，身体清净少有汗垢，但我毕竟还未能练成法力，没法使用去垢除尘的法术。也无法护住衣物不脏。而且我这一身打扮太过扎眼，锦衣华服，不适合赶路，这具身体年龄又小……难免会惹麻烦。”
“还是准备几身青布道袍，寻常百姓的衣物罢！”
“而且三日后的轮回任务，不知是个什么状况。得准备几身换装的打扮……”想到这里钱晨自己打趣道：“这具身体唇红齿白，要说伪装起来，最好打扮成丫鬟小姐。凭着前世的化妆邪术，绝对有前世武侠小说中的易容之功。”
“还要准备一个蒲团，每日勤时修炼，荒郊野外可没有坐榻，只怕打坐久了屁股疼。”
“还有碗筷锅钵，火种刀具，铺盖卧榻，反正乾坤袋中地方还广大，可以多装一点东西。虽然能借袋中的法器施展一些法术妙用，但法术法器这些东西反而扎眼的很。许多时候并不方便，算是我的底牌，应该藏得深一点。”
钱晨在这小县城中绕了一圈，问清楚本地集市的所在，就径直往东市而去。
他的打扮确实扎眼，一路上引人注目，让钱晨暗皱眉头，所以先找了一家布庄进去，当今大晋是个标准的古代王朝，男耕女织，日出而作，日落而息，就算城市之中有些商业活动，在这偏远小县也不算繁盛。
布庄里卖的都是布料，没有成衣的说法。
好在布庄里也有裁缝，方便客人量体裁衣，定制衣物，毕竟自家缝些粗布袍子还好，真正精细的衣衫还得用专门的裁缝。店铺主人看着钱晨是个十四五岁的少年，孤身一人，也有些惊异，但钱晨一身锦衣，像是个出得起价钱的客人，也上来热情招呼。
钱晨问清楚这里定制衣物的时间，知道短则七八日，长则一个月，那店掌柜看他似有不耐，还和气笑道：“小郎君若是要的急，我催促一下，三五日也能拿得出来，只是要加些工钱。”
“钱的事情好说……”钱晨浑不在意这些：“只是我在本县呆不了两日，不耐得等候。”
“你这里可有即将交付给其他客人的衣物，寻一个与我身材相似的，我加钱来买。”妙空留给他的乾坤袋里，铜钱不少，就连黄金白银都有几十斤，所以钱晨还真就不在乎价钱。那店主人面露难色道：“这都是其他客人定制的东西。”
“你重新做就是，他们晚两天有什么打紧的。”钱晨从怀里掏出一小块金子，放在桌面上道：“这些钱够不够。”
那店主人满脸堆笑，接过金子去，点头哈腰道：“够了够了！”
钱晨并非真的如此不耐烦，而是他孤身一人，又是个力弱少年的摸样，若不装出富贵公子的样子，大手大脚的钱怕是会有麻烦。
许是看在黄金的面子上，又或者钱晨装出来的富贵公子像模像样，那店主人把全店合适的成衣都拿了出来，钱晨从里面挑了两件文士衫，打算扮成一个游学的士子，虽然还有破绽，但也比现在这幅扎眼的摸样好多了。
又选了两件粗布短打，虽然有心再选一些不同身份的服饰，但这件店的成衣并没有那么宽裕的选择余地，就连钱晨最想要的道袍都没有。钱晨只好先买下这些，然后和布庄定了两身道袍，加钱急定，日夜赶工的那种。
支使着店内的伙计，出门帮他采买其它用具。伙计跑了整个市场好不容易才把东西凑齐，钱晨付过价钱，又不好用乾坤袋把东西装了走，便吩咐店家把东西送到他暂时落脚的那处荒僻院子里。
伙计有些犹疑道：“那处地方，不是荒废了吗？据说闹鬼……”

钱晨淡漠道：“我暂时在那里落脚，你把东西送过去就是。”
店主人也脸色一变，骂道：“你听先生吩咐就是。”
钱晨才不管他们肚子里有什么猜想，这座小县城也难有什么人能威胁到他，就连这些准备，也只是钱晨一贯谨慎罢了。
再转过一家米粮店，这次就不如意了。
店内最好的米，也不过是本地精米糯稻罢了。莫说没什么灵气，就连水谷精气也不算多，吃下去还要钱晨下苦工来褪化浊气杂质。
其实修行之辈也没有这么讲究，只是钱晨正处于筑基的关头，他又不想浪费功力。
回来和布庄打听了附近有什么道观寺庙，豪门世家，那店主人小心回道：“本县偏僻狭小，未曾有什么大家族，倒是东头有一个小道观，也是道院正经册封的。但是里头三五个道士，也就能施些符水，做几场法事罢了。”
“他们种的什么米？”钱晨问道。
“道观自己种菜，米还是从外面买的。”店主小心查看钱晨脸色，此世神通显世，修行之士也常有来往，剑侠仙人的传说极为盛行，豪门世家以好道为荣，就连朝廷之上也有正经册封的道官，权威极大。
那店主人眼神闪烁，试探问道：“先生可是想求访奇人异士，结交些修道之人啊？”
“莫说修道之人，就是山精狐鬼都可以。”钱晨心里叹息，如果买不到东西，那就只好抢了。天地元气比起上古是有些衰退，但这个世界资源还是比较丰富的，山里面够年头的黄精茯苓，也算是一种灵药了。
只是不如水谷之精温和，将就也能用。
“那小人确实知道一个地方，本地祖荫山上听闻有一窝狐妖，有人夜里看到山间灯火缭绕，狐狸宴饮。”
祖荫山是这县城左近的一个小山，平时少有人去，因为祖荫祖荫，指的是埋葬先人的所在，那里是本地大户的坟山。传说风水不错，所以历来本地的大户都喜欢葬在此地，久而久之，五步一坟，渐渐拥挤，大户们就转而选择其他风水宝地去了。
坟山野狐，倒也应景。
钱晨提气飞纵，脚程极快，用不了半个时辰就到了此山脚下，那山水缭绕，确实有些藏风聚气的形势，只是灵气偏阴，不适合阳宅。

Chapter 3 Borrowing fox food from a lonely grave in a barren mountain
"I need to buy some fresh clothes. Although I have built a Taoist body and my body is clean and free of sweat and dirt, I have not yet developed my magic power and cannot use the magic to remove dirt and dust. Nor can I protect my clothes from getting dirty. Moreover, my outfit is too eye-catching and luxurious, and it is not suitable for traveling. This body is too young... it will inevitably cause trouble."
"It's better to prepare a few green preacher robes, clothes for ordinary people!"
"And I don't know what the situation will be like for the reincarnation mission in three days. I have to prepare a few different costumes..." Thinking of this, Qian Chen joked to himself: "This body has red lips and white teeth. To disguise it, it is best to dress up as a maid. With the makeup magic in the previous life, it must be like the disguise in the martial arts novels in the previous life."
"I also need to prepare a futon and practice diligently every day. There is no couch in the wilderness. I'm afraid my butt will hurt after meditating for a long time."
"There are also bowls, chopsticks, pots and bowls, tinder knives, and bedding. Anyway, the space in the Qiankun Bag is quite large, and you can store a few more things. Although you can use the magic tools in the bag to perform some magical functions, the magic tools are very eye-catching. They are not convenient in many cases. They are my trump card and should be hidden deeper."
Qian Chen walked around this small county town, asked where the local market was, and then went straight to Dongshi.
His dress was really eye-catching and attracted attention along the way, which made Qian Chen secretly frown, so he first found a cloth shop and went in. Today, the Jin Dynasty is a standard ancient dynasty, where men farm and women weave, working at sunrise and resting at sunset. Even if there are some commercial activities in the city, they are not prosperous in this remote county.
Cloth stores sell only fabrics, not ready-made clothes.
Fortunately, there are tailors in the cloth shop, so customers can tailor their clothes and customize their clothes. After all, it is fine to sew some coarse cloth robes at home, but really fine clothes require a specialized tailor. The shop owner was a little surprised when he saw that Qian Chen was a fourteen or fifteen-year-old boy, alone. However, Qian Chen was dressed in rich clothes and looked like a customer who could afford the price, so he came up to greet him warmly.
Qian Chen asked about the time it took to customize clothes here, and found out that it could take as little as seven or eight days, or as long as a month. The shopkeeper seemed to be impatient with him, and smiled kindly: "If you are in a hurry, young man, I'll hurry up and I can get it out in three to five days, but I'll have to pay some extra money."
"It's easy to talk about money..." Qian Chenhun didn't care about this: "It's just that I can't stay in this county for two days and I can't bear to wait."
"Do you have clothes here that will be delivered to other customers? Find one with a similar figure to mine. I'll pay more to buy it." The Qiankun bag Miao Kong left for him contained a lot of copper coins, including dozens of kilograms of gold and silver, so Qian Chen really didn't care about the price. The shop owner looked embarrassed and said, "These are all customized items by other customers."
"You just have to do it again. It doesn't matter if they are two days late." Qian Chen took out a small piece of gold from his pocket, put it on the table and said, "Is this enough money?"
With a smile on his face, the shop owner took the gold, nodded and said, "That's enough, that's enough!"
Qian Chen was not really so impatient, but he was alone and looked like a weak young man. If he didn't pretend to be a wealthy young man, he might be in trouble if he spent too much money.
Perhaps because of the gold, or because Qian Chen pretended to be a rich and wealthy man, the store owner took out all the suitable ready-made clothes in the store. Qian Chen picked two scholar's shirts from them, intending to pretend to be a scholar studying abroad. Although there were still flaws, it was much better than the eye-catching look he had now.
I chose two more coarse cloth shorts. Although I wanted to choose some clothes with different identities, the ready-made clothes in this store did not have such a wide choice, not even the Taoist robe that Qian Chen wanted most. Qian Chen had no choice but to buy these first, and then order two Taoist robes from the cloth shop. He added money and rushed to order, working day and night.
Instruct the clerk in the store to go out to help himPurchase other equipment. The clerk went all over the market to collect the items with great difficulty. Qian Chen had paid the price but couldn't put the items away in a Qiankun bag, so he ordered the store to deliver the items to the remote yard where he temporarily stayed.
The clerk hesitated and said: "Isn't that place deserted? It is said to be haunted..."
Qian Chen said indifferently: "I will stay there for the time being. You just need to send your things there."
The shop owner's expression also changed and he cursed: "You just follow my husband's orders."
Qian Chen didn't care what suspicions they had in their stomachs. It was hard for anyone in this small county to threaten him. Even these preparations were just Qian Chen's usual caution.
I visited another rice and grain store, but this time I was not satisfied.
The best rice in the store is just local polished glutinous rice. Not to mention that there is not much spiritual energy, even the essence of water and grain is not much. If you eat it, you will have to work hard to eliminate the impurities of the turbid energy.
In fact, practitioners are not so particular, but Qian Chen is at the critical moment of building a foundation, and he doesn't want to waste his energy.
When I came back, I asked Buzhuang about any Taoist temples and wealthy families nearby. The shop owner carefully replied: "This county is remote and small, and there are no big families. There is a small Taoist temple in the east end, which is officially canonized by the Taoist temple. But the three or five Taoist priests in it can only cast some talismans and perform a few rituals."
"What kind of rice do they grow?" Qian Chen asked.
"The Taoist temple grows its own vegetables, and the rice is bought from outside." The shopkeeper carefully checked Qian Chen's face. In this world, magical powers are manifested, and practitioners often come and go. Legends of swordsmen and immortals are extremely popular. Rich families are proud of their good Taoism. Even the imperial court has formal Taoist officials with great authority.
The shop owner's eyes flickered and he asked tentatively: "Sir, do you want to visit some strange people and make some friends with Taoists?"
"Not to mention people who are cultivators, even mountain spirits, foxes and ghosts can do it." Qian Chen sighed in his heart. If he couldn't buy something, he would have to rob it. The vitality of heaven and earth has declined somewhat compared to ancient times, but this world is still relatively rich in resources. The old Polygonatum odorifera and Poria cocos in the mountains can be regarded as a kind of elixir.
It's just not as mild as the essence of water and grains, so it can be used casually.
"That little man does know a place. I heard that there is a nest of fox monsters on the local Zuyin Mountain. Some people saw lights on the mountain at night and foxes feasting."
Zuyin Mountain is a hill near the county town. Few people usually go there, because Zuyin Zuyin refers to the place where ancestors are buried. It is the tomb of a large local family. Legend has it that the Feng Shui is good, so the local wealthy families have always liked to be buried here. Over time, every five steps to the grave gradually became crowded, and the wealthy families turned to other Feng Shui treasures.
The wild foxes in the graveyard are also suitable for the occasion.
Qian Chen raised his energy and flew forward, walking very fast. It took him less than half an hour to reach the foot of the mountain. The mountains and rivers were surrounded by mountains and rivers. It was indeed a situation of hiding wind and gathering energy, but the spiritual energy was yin, which was not suitable for Yangzhai.
